reviewMethod: Independent source-file inspection against real capture provenance and asset hashes; no capture rerun and no source edits. This reviews truth and synchronization, not the final encoded export.

checks.note: Key SFX are editorial overlays aligned to decoded real keyboard-event footage; they do not imply microphone capture.

checks.evidence: Report labels Step 8, return-opener, 500 ms timeout and retains unavailable endpoint wording. Current browser proof independently asserts BODY after Escape. The Reel explicitly says Saved report · endpoint sample unavailable.

Pretty UI / Where’s focus?; working dialog; controlled fault; focus returns to opener; Document body; Focus left every control are supported by source UI and asserted activeElement states. No compliance, customer, adoption, universal-browser or public-release qualification claims.

scopeLimits: The failing behavior is an intentional lost-return fixture, clearly labelled Controlled fault / Controlled demo.
Fresh BODY focus evidence and saved checkpoint report are different runs, correctly distinguished on screen.
No claim is made that the five-maintainer pilot or three independent installations have been completed.
GitHub repository is public; local 127.0.0.1 demo is not a hosted public app. Reel CTA uses the public repository.
Capture source paths include local absolute paths in provenance; no secrets or participant data observed.
